segments.name: Land and Water Resources
segments.description: Comprises all activities regarding the company's eastern Mojave Desert properties, pre-revenue development of the Mojave Groundwater Bank, and agricultural operations.
segments.evidence: Our largest segment is Land and Water Resources, which comprises all activities regarding our properties in the eastern Mojave Desert, pre-revenue development of the Mojave Groundwater Bank (supply, storage and conveyance), and agricultural operations.

segments.name: Water Filtration Technology
segments.description: Provides innovative water filtration technology solutions for impaired or contaminated groundwater sources through ATEC.
segments.evidence: Our second operating segment is Water Filtration Technology comprised of ATEC which provides innovative water filtration technology solutions for impaired or contaminated groundwater sources.

revenueModel.text: Revenues come primarily from ATEC water filtration sales to customers, sales of alfalfa harvests, and rental income from agricultural leases.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues have been limited primarily to ATEC sales and sales from our alfalfa plantings and rental income from our agricultural leases.

changes.text: In 2022, the company acquired the assets of ATEC Systems, Inc., forming its Water Filtration Technology segment.
changes.evidence: In 2022, we completed the acquisition of the assets of ATEC Systems, Inc., a producer of specialized filtration systems for removal of common groundwater contaminants that pose health risks in drinking water, including iron, manganese, arsenic, nitrates, Chromium 6 and other constituents of concern.
